subject: Knit2pdf - Chunks options - Change font style

messages.author: f8b7c6eae8e5aa1d
messages.subject: Knit2pdf - Chunks options - Change font style
parts:
Hi,

I'm wondering how to change the font family of code chunks inside a knitr2pdf report. chunk_opts can define the font size, the background and so  on, but even looking at css files, I diddn't find any way to set a proper typefont. For example, I'd like to use a sans-serif font for my R code chunks outputs.

Any idea where to look or how to adress this issue ?

Thanks a lot.

Robin

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Knit2pdf - Chunks options - Change font style
parts:
sans-serif would be an odd choice for program code, although there are
indeed some people using it; a monospaced font is more common.

Anyway, it is a pure LaTeX problem; you can redefine the default
type-writer font, e.g. using the Latin Modern font:

\renewcommand{\ttdefault}{lmtt}

Regards,
Yihui
